summary: The /beta demand-validation landing was explored across desktop, 390px mobile, and 320px narrow mobile after deterministic gates passed. The review covered ad-to-landing message match, the five-question result-before-email funnel, the neutral negative branch, fail-closed lead recovery, active-stage focus handoff, named follow-up radio groups, and the max-height 320px localized follow-up panel at the captured 390px viewport across start, middle, and end states. Independent frontend review and public design authority both returned Findings 0.
remainingRisks: Production email capture and paid ads remain disabled until operator privacy facts, production Turnstile keys and hostname, allowed origin, edge rate-limit evidence, and explicit readiness approval exist.
A fresh final authority review and Stage 6 closeout remain after the Stage 4 frontend merge.
checks: marketing Playwright flow: 10 passed, 2 skipped by project design
marketing visual regression: Darwin and Ubuntu platform baselines passed
deterministic mobile Lighthouse: performance/accessibility 1.0, LCP 1675-1676ms, CLS 0

checklistCoverage.notes: 1280, 390, and 320 evidence shows the locked campaign copy, primary CTA, privacy link, and phone-only proof without reproducing the full poster.
Browser flow and result/email evidence confirm five single-choice questions and result/concept exposure before email.
Browser geometry locks equal intent buttons; negative branch ends without rendering the email field.
Fail-closed browser evidence preserves the result and entered email while showing a retryable error and storing no lead.
Start, middle, and end screenshots at the 390px viewport show the max-height 320px panel, fixed skip/complete actions, visible more cue, second question, and cue removal at the end.
Unit tests cover section scroll/title focus and named radio groups; axe smoke passed on all three Playwright projects.
Runtime evidence and current-head Ubuntu/Darwin visual checks show no horizontal overflow or layout collapse at required viewports.
Independent design and code reviews found no blocker, major, minor, coercive copy, duplicate CTA, or placeholder UI issue.
